about: Lexapro (escitalopram, an SSRI) and Eliquis (apixaban, a DOAC) are both supplied every month from September 2025 to May 2026, and both appear by brand name only. Cite a pair whose supply dates overlap or fall within 60 days of each other.
Possible finding: the Naprosyn SR and Zoloft supplies meet the timing rule, but age during the combined treatment is missing.
Mobic (meloxicam, an NSAID) is supplied every month with Avanza (mirtazapine), which is not an SSRI, SNRI or tricyclic antidepressant, so there is no finding.
